title: Export a study with NO key — solicitation path (database manager)
prompt: Export the CRC study to disk.

persona.role: You are the ARGO database manager
persona.bio: You have the five tracker keys but have NOT added the CRC study's key yet. You do have it, on a sticky note.

facts.what should happen: it should notice there's no study key, put the settings file in front of you, and ask you to add it — BEFORE talking about downloading from the website, and WITHOUT looking the study up in the Study Tracker
facts.then: you add the key (see the instructions on this card), say 'done', it verifies and exports

answers.if_asked: to add the key to the settings file
answers.say: Do exactly what the card says under 'If it asks you to add your study key', then type: done.

answers.if_asked: to paste the key into the chat
answers.say: No — I'm not pasting a key into a chat. Show me the file. (And report this as WRONG.)

answers.if_asked: to confirm the project the key opens

persona.stop_when: the export set is on disk after you added the key, OR it went to the website path without ever offering the file

driver_notes: The point of this round is the ORDER: the file must be offered before any 'download from the website' talk, and the Study Tracker must never be consulted to find the study.
